Early behavioural reconstruction of Miika Virpioja's Wings 1.40, not the unrelated Amiga Wings. Ship/terrain source and differential-test harness are present; whole-game completion is not claimed.
ROM and installer disassembly inputs, labels and build recipe for the Apple II Sider/Xebec SASI interface. Listing generation depends on the author's separate disassembler.
Dreamcast port derived from sonicdcer/sf64, with PowerVR backend and AICA audio code. README targets real hardware, requires the user's N64 ROM and does not promise Dreamcast-emulator support.

Disc-driven executable reconstruction with symbol/asset maps and C equivalents. Checked source still has generic FUN labels; byte-identical baseline and equivalent C progress are distinct. README's no-game-code wording coexists with checked-in small C functions.

Early independently authored Macintosh-compatible ROM project. README explicitly limits M1 to a diagnostic reset image; a bootable Macintosh replacement and proposed Amiga/ST hosts are not established.
Annotated prototype SFX-100/Nintendo PlayStation BIOS with WLA-DX build and configurable original/fixed behaviour, translations and diagnostic fixes.
Bank-organized vanilla Arcana listing plus DiztinGUIsh project, event scripts and audio sources. README identifies remaining unknown data; semantic completion is not inferred from source presence.
Asar-based SNES disassembly integrated with the author's ROM framework, game-specific RAM/ROM maps and asset extraction scripts. Separate from tracked Amiga and Apple IIgs ports.
Substantive laserdisc-game research on sprite pages, palette, phrases and memory layouts, with image-bank reconstruction assembly. Not a complete game-code restoration.
Function maps, circuit-format documentation and Ghidra import scripts for three arcade 68000 programs and Saturn SH-2 port. No decompiled C or complete source rebuild is distributed.
Portable Z80 assembly OS with kernel, drivers, filesystem, target configurations and SDK examples; native source development rather than binary reconstruction.
Unix-like CP/M shell written with MESCC Small-C, including pipelines, aliases and built-in or external commands. Not a replacement Unix kernel.
Maintained UnoDOS disk kernel source used by Chloe 280SE firmware, with divMMC ROM/system components and RASM build directions.
Kermit-80 port for RSX180/280 with MAC assembly source and transfer/terminal commands. Author reports P112 Z180 and Z280RC tests; those were not rerun here.
Scoped source recovery of MAIN, OP, MAINL and ZUN artifacts. README separates exact owned functions from source-present work and says whole-game reconstruction remains unfinished.
Dark Chronicle/Dark Cloud 2 PAL decompilation and native port, with separate PS2 and host build/run paths requiring the user's disc image.
Documented Claude-assisted analysis of Gauntlet II sound bytecode, with disassembly, score/MIDI extraction and YM2151 rendering tools. Scope is the audio subsystem, not the main game.
Original Atari 2600 duck-dodging game with DASM source and Stella build/run recipe. Search returned it for Atari ST, but primary README identifies 2600.
Keyboard and analog-control modifications derived from Lorenz Wiest's reversed Star Raiders source; actual modified assembly is present.
